text.id: deepfake4-While the CNN+LSTM combo is an industry staple, Zashariâ€™s research highlights the raw power of the Capsule Network. When pitted against the CNN+LSTM model, the Capsule Network dominates in understanding spatial hierarchies, achieving a staggering 99.9% accuracy rate.

deepfake4-To push the limits even further, an experimental "model_big.py" architecture fused the Capsule Network with a massive 512-unit LSTM layer. Trained on a hyper-focused dataset of over 1,600 videos, this hybrid approach aims to combine the unmatched spatial awareness of capsules with the temporal tracking of an LSTM. It's a heavy computational lift, but in the arms race against deepfakes, extreme accuracy is the only metric that matters.
